title: the MM2 letters TUV walk - the tarrasque to vulture turns
audit_label: R814 MM2 letters TUV walk audit
audit_comment: THE MM2 LETTERS TUV WALK - the tarrasque p. 117 (its treasure and lair cells the See-below read), the tasloi p. 118, the giant harvester termite variant table pp. 118-119 (the worker and soldier columns, plus the king and queen the royal-pair inline stats), the thessalhydra, the thri-kreen, the thunder beast and the time elemental p. 119, the thunderherder p. 120, the transposer p. 120, the tri-flower frond p. 121, the troll marine (scrag) variant table p. 121 (the fresh and salt water columns), the twilight bloom and the land urchin p. 122, the ustilagor p. 122 and the vagabond pp. 122-123, the vargouille p. 123, the vegepygmy, the verme and the vilstrak p. 124, the vulchling and the vulture variant table p. 125 (the giant and ordinary columns); the TUV-FLIP round: the Letter T, U and V gap boxes flip to closed (27 closed, 10 open). TWENTY-SIX .lua defs ride the R791 data_files extension, registry 766 -> 792; TWENTY-ONE entry heads carrying TWENTY-TWO stat blocks (the termite royal pair the one extra block), no prior-owned heads, no doctrine-only heads. THE SETTLED READS (capture primary, the 1eonline transcription the cross-check voice): the tarrasque 300 hp the flat-hp path (hdNum 0) and its AC -3 the UNQUOTED number (the phoenix precedent); the transposer xp VI/625 the capture-wins read (the transcription 525); the scrag saltwater 6+12 the capture-wins read (the transcription 5+12); the thessalhydra IX/5800 (the capture 5S00, the S an 8 artifact, the transcription the confirm); the ordinary vulture AC 6 the capture-wins read (the transcription 7) and the two vulture xp rows pinned verbatim (the giant I/20 + 2/hp, the ordinary II/35 with no per-hp - the print rows as printed, not a ladder); the vegepygmy HD 1 to 6 the low-end read with its 6-rung xp ladder pinned as consts (53+1, 81+2, 120+3, 175+4, 245+5, 425+6 - the R812 rider precedent) and its treasure O, T, P the capture-wins read (the transcription Q, P); the ustilagor intelligence Unstable the capture-wins read (the transcription Unratable); the land urchin 2-12 spines the loader 10 clamp; the vilstrak 1-6 hp the flat-hp high-end read 6 (the scum creeper precedent); the vagabond the nil block (the phantom precedent - the As-form cells, AC the 9 default, xp 0); the print typos pinned where both voices agree (the lejendary tarrasque, the tranposer, Tarterus, the parallel unverse); every Standard, See-below, As-form and Special magic resistance 0; the percent lair cells the bare-numeral read (the R812 repair lesson). REPAIR OF THE FIRST CUT: the vagabond hitDiceNum cell was authored as the string "As form" and the regtest walk came back bad 1 - the loader hitDiceNum default is 1, so a non-numeric cell rides the default instead of reading 0; the cell is now the numeric "0" - the shade precedent; the offline loader sim was taught the default-1 semantics (the new sim gate class) so this cannot recur unseen; no other byte changed.

tables.name: the tarrasque to vulture stat grid
tables.audit_comment: THE TUV-GRID: the 26-row TUVStats stat grid (every armor class, hit-dice, bonus, avgHp, attack, xp, xp/hp, lair, move and magic-resistance cell of the twenty-six promoted letters TUV stat blocks, in print order - the tarrasque p. 117 through the ordinary vulture p. 125)
col_comments: The armor class cells (the tarrasque -3 the UNQUOTED number read - the phoenix precedent; the tasloi 6 (5), the termite 2/10 and 2/8 head/body and the verme 3 (head) the first-int reads; the ordinary vulture 6 the capture-wins read against the transcription 7; the vagabond As form the 9 default - the shade precedent)

The hit dice num cells (the tarrasque and vilstrak the flat-hp path - hdNum 0, avgHp the print hp: 300 and 6 the high-end; the thunder beast 4-9, +1/die and the time elemental 12 or 16 (20) the first-number reads; the vegepygmy 1 to 6 the low-end read; the transposer 6 (up to 48 hp) the 6 read; the vagabond As form the 0 read)
The hit dice bonus cells (the verme 18+18 the +18; the termite king 6+6 and queen 8+8; the scrag saltwater 6+12 the capture-wins read against the transcription 5+12)

The avgHp cells (the floor(3.5 x hd + bonus) formula; the flat-hp reads carry the print hp: the tarrasque 300, the vilstrak 6 the high-end read - the scum creeper precedent; the vagabond the nil block 0 - the phantom precedent)

The attack cells (the loader semantics: the land urchin 2-12 the 10 clamp, the tasloi 2 or 1, the thri-kreen 5 or 3 and the vulchling 1 or 2 the max reads, the thessalhydra Up to 10 the 10 read, the tri-flower and twilight bloom See below and the vagabond As form the 1 floor)

The xp base cells (the vagabond Variable the 0 read - the phantom precedent; the transposer 625 the capture-wins read against the transcription 525; the thessalhydra 5800 the 5S00 capture read; the ordinary vulture II/35 with no per-hp)
The xp per hit point cells (the vegepygmy 1-6 ladder the 1/hp low rung; the ordinary vulture the 0 read; the verme 25 and the time elemental 20 the highest letter-TUV rates)
The lair percent cells (the bare-numeral read - the R812 repair lesson; the ustilagor 90 and vargouille 80 the highest letter-TUV rates; the tarrasque See below the 0 read; the vagabond 0)

The move cells (the walking-rate first-int read: the vultures 3"/24" and 3"/27", the scrags 3"/15" and 3"/12" the 3 reads, the vargouille /12" the flight-rate 12 read, the thunder beast 9" (18" charge) the 9 read; the tri-flower and twilight bloom Nil the 0 reads; the vagabond As form the 0 read)
The magic resistance cells (every Standard, See below, As form and Special, see below read 0 - no letter-TUV def carries an innate percent)
